title: radiation constant digits
text: `a_rad` is stored to five digits, $4.4\times10^{-6}$ below the value computed from $k_B$, $h$, $c$; the shift propagates to $\varepsilon$, $\Phi$ and $P_{\rm conv}$ equally. A proposal to store more digits is canon work and waits for approval.

title: the quoted polynomial
text: The comment at `laws.hpp:2404` gives the polynomial of $T(2,5)$ for the $(2,3)$ mode. Proposed correction, pending approval: replace it by $t^{-1}-1+t$.

title: `step_locus` near the centre
text: The loss of accuracy of Table 8.3, and the proposed half-angle form.

title: a stale comment
text: The engine's comment at the transfer function gives $2.125\times10^{-17}$; the executed value is $2.1242\times10^{-17}$.

title: the capacity function
text: `contact_capacity` exceeds the exact maximum for $\max(Z,N)<3$; proposed correction $\min(3Z,3N,ZN)$, not applied.

title: the engine's capacity function
text: `contact_capacity` equals (21.1) except for $(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)$ (R19.5; proposal, not applied).

title: stored constants (proposal to the author, canon untouched)
text: `cosmology::wien_peak` carries $2.898\times10^{-3}$ and `a_rad` is rounded to five digits; the computed values above are available if the author chooses to replace them.

title: engine comment (proposal to the author, canon untouched)
text: The comment on `z_spectral` states the gravitational redshift as $z_e-z_o$; the second-order difference from (45.1) is not recorded there.

title: stored alpha binding (proposal to the author, canon untouched)
text: `B_alpha` is rounded to five digits; the computed value from measured masses is available.

title: stored scales (proposal to the author, canon untouched)
text: The comment relating $R_{\rm CMB}$ to $\ln(1+z)/\sigma_0$ is off by $0.76$–$0.90$ per cent, and the stored `age_SDT_Gyr` (48) and $R_{\rm CMB}/c$ (100.7 Gyr) differ by $2.1$; the two could be reconciled or labelled in `cosmology.hpp`.

title: unguarded domains
text: `clock_rate`, `depth_from_c_far` and the others in Section 57.2 do not check their domains (proposal to the author, canon untouched).
